{{Quote|Swoop jockeys have the brains of a blister gnat&ndash;and about the same life expectancy.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>}}
'''Gnats''' were small insects with short lifespans. They were usually flying in black swarms and lived in humid areas. Types of gnat were the [[blister gnat]], the [[Fire gnat/Legends|fire gnat]], the [[Rodian kelp gnat]] and the [[parfue gnat]].

They preyed on [[honeyboar]]s.<ref name="ss">''[[Stock Ships]]''</ref>
